 Prayer :

Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of Cr.P  to call for the records relating to the complaint in C.C.No.1219 of  on the file of the learned X Metropolitan Magistrate, Egmore, Chenn  and quash the same.
For Petitioner : Mr.R.Harishankar  For Respondents : Mr.A.Gokulakrishnan

This Criminal Original Petition filed is under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., to call for the records relating to the final report filed in C.C.No.1219 of 2020 on the file of the learned X Metropolitan Magistrate,
Egmore, Chennai, for the offence u/s.59(1) and 52(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and quash the same.

2.When this Court was about to dismiss the present petition after hearing the submissions of the learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned counsel sought indulgence of this Court to dispense with the personal appearance of the petitioners before the trial Court.

The personal appearance of the petitioners before the Trial Court shall be dispensed with, provided that, they shall be present for receiving the charge sheet, for answering the charge, at the time of questioning under Section 313, Cr.P.C and at the time of passing judgment.
Consequently, the connected Crl.M.P.No.6093 of 2022 is ordered and Crl.M.P.No.6090 of 2022 is closed.
